about: Every vision_pool build deployed on mainnet, or recorded as a candidate to deploy. sha256 is the .so file; executableHash is the same bytes without trailing zeros, which `solana-verify get-program-hash` prints for the deployed program. program/BUILD.md explains how to rebuild and check an entry.

releases.reproduced: 2026-10-14: program/scripts/build.sh, offline and with no keys in the build folder, built these exact bytes from the program sources at source.commit with program/Cargo.lock; the on-chain program data holds exactly these bytes followed by zero padding.
releases.notes: The program sources in this repository rebuild these exact bytes with program/Cargo.lock. sourceSha256 covers Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and programs/ as build.sh hashes them at source.commit.
